material_status: public authoring contract only; no unseen cases or answers
pre_execution_validation: Validate every fixture fingerprint, exact source and sink span, connected path, concrete value identity, taxonomy tuple, barrier, mutation inverse, and eligibility before sealing.
Validate schemas, licenses, provenance, duplicate identities, answer leakage, privacy, and deterministic reconstruction before sealing.
Public summaries disclose only aggregate design counts and commitment hashes, never case source, case identifiers, assignments, expectations, or mutation answers.
immutable_commitments: Commit the taxonomy, evidence contract, evaluator tree, adapter policy, process-status policy, per-file hashes, aggregate corpus hash, contract Merkle root, manifest hash, and genesis ledger hash before execution.
Any post-seal change creates a new holdout version; sealed artifacts are never regenerated in place.
counterbalancing: Balance vulnerable/control assignment and presentation order within every declared stratum.
Measure and publish factor intersections before sealing without exposing case answers.
Reject duplicate templates, correlated answer positions, and factor cells below the preregistered minimum.
isolation: Run every scanner process in a fresh read-only fixture copy with outbound network access blocked.
Use explicit argument arrays, bounded output, process groups, timeouts, resource limits, and sanitized environment provenance.
Hash fixture copies before and after execution and retain per-process isolation attestations.
one_shot_execution: Reserve execution in an append-only chained ledger before starting the first case.
Execute each eligible case exactly once; do not rerun failures, unfavorable outcomes, malformed output, or timeouts.
Account for every case and terminate the ledger exactly once with immutable artifact hashes.
process_status_policy: Adjudicate report authority before interpreting a normal nonzero exit code.
Distinguish policy findings exits, genuine crashes, timeouts, missing output, malformed output, internal report errors, clean reports, and findings reports.
Never grant clean credit to a failed, missing, malformed, timed-out, or internally errored execution.
answer_confidentiality: Keep expectations, mutation answers, matcher inputs, and fixture classifications outside scanner-visible trees and commands.
Reject secrets, credentials, absolute paths, usernames, private endpoints, and answer-bearing filenames.
post_run_retirement: Publish the preregistered aggregate result, raw accounting, limitations, and complete provenance without ranking or superiority claims.
Retire and disclose the holdout after its designated lifecycle; all later use is development regression, not an unbiased examination.
Preserve the original one-shot result and ledger even if a later protocol defect is found; corrections are additive and separately versioned.
